profile.headline: Software/Systems/DevOps Engineer | Seeking new opportunities
profile.summary: I'm a Software Engineer with a passion for building and optimizing high-impact solutions across commercial and aerospace industries. I thrive in fast-paced environments, tackling complex challenges and ensuring systems run smoothly. I have experience in Python, React, and Angular, as well as DevOps, CI/CD, and system integration. I have a strong passion for designing, troubleshooting, and optimizing system performance. I’ve worked closely with cross-functional teams in both Agile and Waterfall environments, helping to streamline workflows and improve system performance. Whether it’s debugging a critical issue, optimizing an application, or collaborating on a new feature, I’m always looking for ways to make an impact!

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Designed and shipped ShipCaptain, a multi-tenant shipping, order, and warehouse management SaaS, building a Turborepo monorepo of Next.js/React/TypeScript apps (CarrierConnect, OMS, WMS, Online, Billing) on a shared PostgreSQL/Prisma backend.
• Enabled real-time rating, label creation, tracking, and bulk shipping across USPS, UPS, FedEx, and UniUni by developing Go REST and WebSocket microservices with circuit breakers and Redis-backed rate limiting.
• Powered multi-channel fulfillment by integrating Shopify, Amazon, and TikTok order management with Stripe wallet billing and OAuth/2FA authentication.
• Drove reliable, automated deployments by owning AWS infrastructure, containerizing services with Docker on EKS (Kubernetes), and building CI/CD pipelines with automated testing and security scanning.
• Ensured consistent, high-quality delivery by leading a small engineering team, running daily stand-ups, conducting code reviews, and enforcing coding standards across the monorepo.
• Bridged business and engineering by driving customer onboarding, technical requirements reviews, and stakeholder demos backed by clear technical documentation.

positions.title: Frontend Developer
positions.description:
• Rehauled a span of different AI tools, used to streamline the process of buying and selling cars online, enhancing their dynamic and user-friendliness, using React, TypeScript, scss, and Firebase.
• Redesigned Pacer’s home page, core applications and tools; prioritized mobile responsiveness and aesthetic simplicity, and improved user interaction.
•Designed interactive prototypes and demos in Figma, aligning future products with user needs and business goals.
positions.insights: Skills: Front-End Development · TypeScript · React · Scss · Cloud Firestore

positions.title: Systems Engineer
positions.locationName: Redondo Beach, California, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
-Developed automated test scripts in Python for regression testing of software requirements intended for satellite deployment. This involved using a SEIT framework to send data via Kafka, update and check databases using SQL, processing algorithms in real-time, matching data with JSON formatting for desired results, and output results to an HTML file for knowledge share. 

-Documented STC Documents outlining detailed test steps for software requirements, These documents were shared on Confluence to promote knowledge sharing and coordination among various teams. 

-Collaborated with cross-functional teams to identify, document, and communicate bugs discovered during testing and debugging. Created detailed tickets in Jira, managed code from various repositories in Bitbucket, and coordinated via Microsoft Teams to devise effective bug resolution strategies

-Conducted live testing with O&I, actively troubleshooting and documenting observations on the performance and issues encountered on our scripts. 

-Configured and set up Linux virtual machines for testing, incorporating bash scripting to automate and streamline the setup process.
positions.insights: Skills: Automation · Python (Programming Language) · Problem Solving · Regression testing · Technical Documentation · Troubleshooting · Regression Testing · Functional Test Design · Shell Scripting · Agile · Software Integration and testing · Test Automation · Secure Shell (SSH)

positions.title: Production Service Engineer
positions.description:
-Monitored and managed service quality with knowledge of monitoring and management tools, service provider and voice technologies, IP telephone, and Conferencing solutions. 

-Collaborated with multiple tiers of support, taking on escalations. Investigated complex issues using WEB/Client/Server/Database service, and debugged complex different OS environments and platforms, such as Windows Servers, Android, and Mac OS Servers.

-Collected information, design process, and troubleshooting documentation for the support knowledge base. 

-Prioritized and addressed high-priority service challenges, providing updates and coordinating solutions with team members, engineering, and other departments to restore services to a high standard.

- Offered live technical support and troubleshooting during real-time client calls, working closely with TSMs and TAMs to quickly resolve issues.

-Debugged diverse components of the Zoom client-server system, employing a wide range of tools and investigative approaches. This included utilizing and troubleshooting different layers of the OSI model, from TCP/IP packet tracking to network debugging to the Application and physical diagnostics to effectively troubleshoot the issues.

-Deployed and managed numerous containers using Docker and AWS cloud services, including S3, to maintain, optimize, and enhance specific aspects related to escalated issues.
positions.insights: Skills: Windows Server · Microsoft Endpoint Configuration Manager · Network Troubleshooting · IT Operations · Log Analysis · Active Directory · Cisco Routers · Problem Solving · Technical Documentation · Escalation Resolution · Network Debugging · Wireless Networking · Escalations Management · Microsoft Exchange · Routing · Network Administration · Team Coordination · Microsoft Office · Citrix Products · Computer Network Operations · Debugging · Containerization

positions.title: Front Desk Receptionist
positions.description: Utilizing exceptional customer service to assist students with any questions they may have concerning the Office of Registrar

positions.title: DevOps Intern
positions.description:
-Implemented many solutions to optimize multiple TDM Microservices and APIs, using Javascript and C#.

-Integrated a tool using JavaScript and PowerBI to simplify and automate the process of displaying integral information to an interactive dashboard.

-Upheld best DevOps practices and pipeline setup, leveraging CI/CD tools like Jenkins and Ansible to -streamline development, testing, and deployment processes, ensuring successful project outcomes.

-Proactively contributed to the development of a business case solution that automated registration and scheduling for the SAFe class offered by Travelport, improving registration by 15%

-Responsible for raising over $2,000 for the Dumb Friends League on Travelport’s behalf.
positions.insights: Skills: Windows DevOps · TypeScript · Jenkins · Problem Solving · API Development · Microservice Development · Ansible · Agile & Waterfall Methodologies · Microsoft Power BI · Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) · Fundraising · Dev · C# · Containerization · DevOps

positions.title: Cyber Security Intern
positions.description:
-Performed vulnerability testing for various U.S. bases and institutions, utilizing tools such as Wireshark and NMAP, to create reports on those vulnerabilities.

-Proficient in Cybersecurity fundamentals, demonstrating comprehensive knowledge in threat detection, vulnerability assessment, and data capture and analysis.

-Automated and formatted hundreds of official documentation and forms using Elastic Search, Access, Word, and Adobe.
positions.insights: Skills: Wireshark · Nmap · Problem Solving · Technical Documentation · Network Debugging · Threat Detection · Cybersecurity · Vulnerability Assessment
